reviews.text: Dedicated care for pets. Gabriel takes care of our pets as if they were his own. Lots of affection, care, and tranquility – the dogs adore him!

DogWellness has been my girls' second home for years. They go every week, and when we need to travel or have an emergency, DogWellness is where I trust to leave my girls. I can only thank and praise the entire team for their work and welcoming atmosphere ❤️

My pet has been going to Dog Wellness since 2015 and she simply loves it! She feels great surrounded by doggy friends and pampered by the staff! Every time I travel, Nina stays at Well. I trust them completely! I highly recommend them!
I've known the service for 14 years. It just keeps getting better. They are extremely careful with the dogs, both in their treatment and their health. My dog ​​loves Dogwellness.

Wonderful, 5-star hotel for my dogs, for years! I don't leave them with anyone else! Haha
I have a lot of confidence in everyone's work; they are very careful with the specific needs and personality of each dog. Especially for dogs undergoing medical treatment, it's the best daycare/hotel option in São Paulo!
The girls at Dog Wellness take great care of Chiquita.
No further comment needed, the service and commitment of the entire team is top-notch. Congratulations to everyone at Dog Wellness!

Dog is one of the most special places I've ever seen. From the reception/security staff, to the cleaning and grooming teams, all the veterinarians who care for the pets, the head veterinarian, the physiotherapist, the finance team, the manager, the owner – everyone is impeccable. You can feel the positive energy of the place as soon as you walk in. The dogs are always very calm and happy, and the environment is clean and organized. The videos and photos they send throughout the day are taken with the utmost care and attention to detail. They are experts at what they do and, above all, they really enjoy their work, and that's clear. Since my dog ​​started going to Dog, I've seen very few (in fact, I don't remember any) staff changes; you can tell it's a super close-knit and relaxed group! They inspire a lot of confidence and tranquility. Now, the quality of life that Dog has provided for my dog ​​(who arrived already quite old, with mobility difficulties) is inexplicable; he has rejuvenated, become happier, improved his motor skills, and lost weight healthily. Being at Dog is, without a doubt, one of the main factors that is giving him quality of life during this delicate time. My dog, my family, and I have always been very well received and guided. To the entire Dog team, our sincerest thanks!
Excellent; I recommend it.

We love DogWellness! The staff is extremely attentive, caring, and professional. Our three dogs have always been very well cared for, including Pingo, who is already 18 years old and simply loves being there. Now Brigite, our little one who is 4 months old, also attends Day Care.

The service conveys a lot of confidence and affection for the animals. Our dogs are like our children, and if they are well, we are too. I always travel with peace of mind; I've even left them for a month at their daycare, knowing that they are in excellent hands at DogWellness. 🐾
The best Hotel and Day Care for Pets in São Paulo

Excellent service! My dog ​​is quite old, 19 years old, and I feel at ease leaving her at Dog Wellness because I know she will be well cared for the entire time, with professionalism, dedication, and lots of affection.

Simply the best experience I've ever had with a dog park!

Dog Wellness is impeccable in every way: structure, organization, care, and especially the genuine affection for the animals. It's very clear that every detail is thought out for the well-being and safety of the pets.

My dog ​​loves going there, and for me, that's the greatest proof of trust. He always comes back happy, calm, and well cared for. The team is extremely professional, attentive, and transmits a lot of security to us pet owners.

Today I leave my dog ​​at Dog Wellness with complete peace of mind because I know he's in a safe, responsible, and loving environment.

I recommend it without hesitation! Anyone who loves their pet needs to know about Dog Wellness.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Wonderful service with great care and attention, congratulations!

The company's proposal is very good, but my experience wasn't the best.

A few years ago, I had to leave my pet at a pet hotel because I had a trip planned. However, she left the hotel reacting negatively to some breeds (especially Golden Retrievers), even though until that week she was completely friendly and tolerant with everyone.

Since then, I've spent a lot of money and time on training, and I still can't leave her at a daycare because we haven't been able to completely improve her behavior...

I've worked in a daycare before and I know very well how it works, which is why I chose this one and also why I took so long to review it here, because I didn't want to harm the company. But after so much expense, headache, and reflection, I felt it necessary to clarify so that measures can be taken to prevent other pet owners from suffering the same fate as I did!

I am absolutely certain it was this hotel/daycare, with this name, which was previously located on Natingui Street. I just wanted to share my story so that this kind of situation doesn't happen again, because this is one of the choices I deeply regret, but I can't go back! =/

This is my plea!
A safe, clean environment with lots of love. Chico loved his stay! 🐶 …
The best daycare and boarding facility my precious jewel could ever stay in.
What a wonderful experience my dog ​​had with Dog Wellness! A welcoming place and great staff. I recommend them without hesitation, thank you so much for taking such good care of my dog.
Wonderful place, everything organized and clean, everyone very friendly, loving and caring with the animals!

My experience with this pet hotel was excellent! From the moment I booked, I received excellent service and had all my questions answered. The space is organized and welcoming, with ample areas for pets to play and rest.

I left my pet at this hotel and was very satisfied with the experience. The staff was extremely attentive and caring from the first contact. The place is spacious, clean, and well-organized, which gave me confidence that he would be safe and comfortable.

I really liked knowing that they have a routine with activities, including games and activities, which helped keep my pet active and entertained. In addition, they maintained his feeding according to my instructions, which was great because he didn't find the food strange.

The communication was excellent! I received photos and videos daily, which reassured me and showed that he was having fun. At the end of his stay, he returned home happy and healthy, which is a great sign that he was well cared for.

I found the cost fair for the service and I recommend it to anyone looking for a safe and high-quality place to leave their pet! Thank you all, Renata, Cristiane, and Amanda 🩷

I have a dog/son who attended daycare three times a week. He has Alzheimer's and can't walk. When he started, they accepted him calmly. After a while, they called me to talk about his day and that he needed 100% support. They charged me extra for this (and it wasn't cheap) to have this support. Weeks later, they called me coldly (the daycare owner) and said they wouldn't take him anymore. Overnight. They didn't even let me plan, because I work and didn't go to work the next day. They only told me 12 hours before his next day (a day-only day). I felt very disrespected. It was inhumane what they did to us. Especially to my dog. In short, they claim to care for special needs animals, but that's not how they treated him. Today I found a place that truly respects and cares for him.

Responding to your comment about my review, yes, I know his condition very well and I am grateful for the care he received during the month and three weeks. But notifying me at such short notice was very disrespectful to me because I always knew about the barking, but never the neighbors. So I felt very lost. He is sick, unfortunately!!!! And I will take care of him as long as God allows. That's why I looked for a place that would accept his conditions. You also know that he is being medicated precisely to control this barking. But anyway, success to you and may God bless you too. I live in an apartment and no one has ever called on the intercom. Because I manage to control it as much as possible. I will continue fighting for him. I did post my dissatisfaction with your attitude, after all it's a daycare for special needs dogs, but it has to be clear that it depends on the severity of the situation. Anyone who loves their animal as much as I love him knows the struggle it is to go through this. May God bless you. I continue fighting for him here. 🙏
Dr. Ricardo is an excellent veterinarian. Prices are average for the market and the environment is welcoming.
Very good as always, Dr. Ricardo is excellent!

Complete confidence in DogWellness. I have a dog with special needs and he is always very well cared for in this place. We tried other places but DogWellness was where he was happiest. I joke that it was his choice and I'm certain he's being cared for 24 hours a day by incredible and well-prepared professionals. I can only express my gratitude.
A very beautiful and cozy place for our furry friends. My four-legged daughter and I were seen by Dr. Ricardo, an excellent professional.

I left my 3 babies there during the end-of-year holidays and I've never felt so safe and at ease.
Excellent facilities, highly trained and caring staff. …
